exposes.summary: The federated component/primitive/template registry behind one Registry<T> port (uniform list/lookup/search/explain): primitives, primitive templates, task/pipeline templates, harnesses, skills, adapters, datasets, source/provenance rows, embeddings, and metadata records.
The seven canonical primitives (Input, Knowledge Corpus, If Statement, Action, Loop, Stop/End, Output), their composition edges, and reusable primitive templates/cards derived from real artifacts.
The tree-sitter AST symbol/edge graph over the codebase (callers, callees, impact, change-audit).
The two-axis lift+durability gap harness that admits a component only if it lifts over the bare model AND the lift is structural.
The tiered record store: config JSON, operational Postgres+pgvector, and history warehouse.
The single-source credential registry — env-var names only, deny-by-default reachability.
